title: Mountain Path
text: A trail climbs through rock and pine between Willowbrook and Greendale. From the overlooks you can see both: Greendale ahead, and Willowbrook small and far behind you. Just off the trail is a camp site where travellers stop for the night.

title: Greendale Gates
text: A magnificent stone archway marks the entrance to Greendale, the largest settlement you have encountered. Guards in polished mail stand watch, banners fluttering in the mountain breeze. Beyond, cobblestone streets wind between stone houses and bustling shops. The air carries the sounds of commerce—a stark contrast to Willowbrook's quiet charm.

title: Main Square
text: The heart of Greendale: a great fountain of old heroes fighting beasts, stalls under bright awnings, red roofs all round. The square is crowded, but the talk is low, and it stops when a guard walks past. Castle towers rise to the north.

title: Market District
text: Narrow streets crammed with shops and trading posts weave a maze of commerce. Spices, leather, and fresh bread scent the air. Merchant wagons clog passageways while deals are argued in several languages. Serious business gets done here.

title: The Silver Stag Inn
text: A three-story inn glows with warm yellow light. Conversations from travelers and locals merge into a comforting din while tales are traded over bread and ale. Stag mounts and adventuring trophies line the walls. The place feels welcoming; information flows here as freely as the drink.

patches.title: Room Key gone

patches.title: Way east open
patches.text: Show the way east open and passable.

title: Inn Rooms
text: Comfortable guest rooms on the upper floor of The Silver Stag Inn. Each room has a cozy bed, a writing desk, and a window overlooking the Market District. The rooms are clean and well-maintained, offering a peaceful retreat for travelers. Faint conversation drifts up from the common room below.

title: Merchant's Warehouse
text: A large stone building packed with goods from distant lands. Crates and barrels form narrow corridors between tall shelving. Exotic spice and lacquer aromas mingle in the cool still air. This is where the most valuable inventory rests under quiet watch.

title: Castle Approach
text: A wide avenue lined with statues of Greendale's heroes leads to an impressive castle of white stone. Tall spires reach toward the sky, and colorful banners snap in the wind. Fewer guards than the posts were built for patrol the approach, and those who remain keep their voices low. The royal standard is gone from the highest spire.

patches.title: Way west open
patches.text: Show the way west open and passable.

title: Castle Courtyard
text: An expansive courtyard within the castle walls, featuring training grounds where knights practice their swordwork. Ancient oak trees provide shade for stone benches, and a stable houses magnificent warhorses, though half its stalls stand empty since the king's own guard rode out to search for him. The castle's main hall rises before you, its great doors carved with the symbols of Greendale's noble houses.

patches.title: Squire's Diary appears
patches.text: Add the squire's diary to the picture.

title: Great Hall
text: A magnificent hall with soaring ceilings supported by massive stone columns. Tapestries depicting legendary battles cover the walls, and the king's throne stands empty on a raised dais at the far end, a dark cloth laid across its arms. Behind it, the doors to the throne room are barred. Sunlight streams through tall stained-glass windows, casting colorful patterns on the stone floor. This is where the lords of Greendale hold court; for now, the Lord Commander holds it alone.

title: Residential Quarter
text: Quiet lanes of two-storey houses, each with a small garden and a workshop. Craftsmen work at benches in the open doorways, and neighbours sit on their steps. Half the garden plots have gone grey.

patches.title: Way secret_passage open
patches.text: Show the way secret_passage open and passable.

title: Healer's House
text: A small stone house that smells of crushed herbs. A few bundles of dried plants still hang from the rafters, but the shelves below them are nearly bare: rows of empty bottles, rinsed and waiting. A fire burns in the hearth, and a door at the back stands half shut.

title: Hidden Library
text: Discovered beneath Greendale through a secret passage, this ancient library holds countless volumes of magical lore. Glowing crystals provide soft illumination and the air hums with residual energy. Protective enchantments shimmer around the most valuable texts. Somewhere on these shelves may be an answer about the mark you carry.

title: Forest Transition
text: The mountain path ends at a ring of standing stones, grey and mossed, with runes cut deep in them. Past the stones the trees begin all at once, close and dark.

patches.title: Way east open
patches.text: Show the way east open and passable.

title: Forest Entrance
text: Massive trees create a natural cathedral as you enter the Enchanted Forest. Dappled sunlight filters through the dense canopy, and the path ahead disappears into green shadows. The air is alive with birds and rustling leaves, but beneath it lies an expectant silence, as if the forest itself is watching.

title: Ancient Grove
text: A ring of trees so old their trunks are wider than a cottage. Signs are carved in their bark, older than any letters you know. In the middle stands one tree taller than the rest, with bark the colour of tarnished silver.

title: Whispering Glade
text: A meadow opens round a small stream that runs over smooth stones. Wildflowers grow thick to the water's edge. Under the sound of the water there are other sounds, almost voices, and they stop when you listen for them.

title: Heart of the Forest
text: The deepest part of the forest. The light here is green and gold and does not seem to come from the sky. A tree vaster than any other holds up the branches overhead, and before it stands an altar of starstone. The only way out is back north, to the grove.

title: Ancient Tree Spirit
text: A face portrait of an ancient tree spirit, a face that appears in silver bark: two knots for eyes, a split in the bark for a mouth, with rings of moss growing across it.

title: Barmaid Elena
text: A face portrait of a young woman with grey lips and tired eyes, her pale skin faintly shadowed, her hair tied back.

title: Brenn
text: A face portrait of a young caravan guard with a wary, startled expression and tousled hair.

title: Caravan Master Thorne
text: A face portrait of a weather-beaten caravan master with road dust in the creases of his skin, squinting eyes and a greying beard.

title: Castle Guard Captain
text: A face portrait of a grey-moustached castle guard captain in a polished steel helm, with a stern, watchful face.

title: Court Herald
text: A face portrait of a prim court herald with a long, pale face and a careful, sceptical look, in a stiff collar stitched with gold thread.

title: Families
text: A face portrait of a smiling villager from a close-knit lane, weathered and warm, with a child’s face peeking beside them.

title: Forest Hermit
text: A face portrait of a thin, weathered hermit under a moss-green hood, with sharp wary eyes and a guarded look.

title: Forest Sprites
text: A face portrait of a tiny forest sprite, a mote of light with a small bright face and wings like a split beech-nut husk.

title: Gate Captain
text: A face portrait of a stern city watch captain in a polished mail coif, with a hard, appraising look.

title: Herald
text: A face portrait of a thin royal herald with a narrow face, a long nose and a hard, scrutinising stare, in a tabard collar bearing the royal arms.

title: Historians
text: A face portrait of an elderly scholar with thick round spectacles, curious and absent-minded.

title: Innkeeper Marcus
text: A face portrait of a big, broad-faced innkeeper with a friendly grin that does not reach his anxious eyes, and a stained apron strap at the shoulder.

title: Local Craftsmen
text: A face portrait of a skilled craftsman with calloused, focused features, a leather cap and sawdust in his beard.

title: Lord Commander
text: A face portrait of a broad, grey-bearded lord commander in ceremonial armour, with a heavy, weary, dignified look.

title: Master Healer Lyria
text: A face portrait of a grey-haired woman healer with a steady, kind and tired face and deep lines at the eyes.

title: Master Merchant Aldric
text: A face portrait of a broad, well-fed merchant in a good coat collar, with a shrewd, appraising stare and a trimmed beard.

title: Mountain Hermit
text: A face portrait of a broad old man with a faded royal-blue cloak hood, a scarred weathered face, white beard and a sentry’s watchful eyes.

title: Nyx
text: A face portrait of a young woman with wild hair and green leaves caught in it, a pale, watchful face and bright, curious eyes.

title: Sir Cedric
text: A face portrait of a tall knight in his fifties with a weathered, tired face and a steady, watchful stare, a steel mail coif and a dented gorget around his neck.

title: Spectral Librarian
text: A face portrait of a ghostly scholar shimmering with soft blue light, translucent and gaunt, with a stern, watchful look.

title: Squires
text: A face portrait of a young squire, flushed and freckled, with a leather practice cap and a sidelong, whispering look.

title: Town Crier
text: A face portrait of a red-faced town crier with round cheeks and a feathered cap.

title: Training Master
text: A face portrait of a grey-haired knight with a rough, weathered face and a hard, sharp-eyed stare.

title: Water Nymphs
text: A face portrait of a water nymph, her face and hair made of clear flowing stream water, with pale shifting eyes.

title: Elior
text: A face portrait of a farm boy of about nineteen, sun-browned and freckled, with untidy brown hair, an earnest, searching look, and the frayed collar of a homespun shirt.
